steps.en: Latest mobile number of the individual hirer is fetched from the data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru hirer individu diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The data source lookup is turned off in all environments, so the number typed by the owner is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ke sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor yang diketik owner yang dipakai.

steps.en: Unique individual hirers are identified and their notices combined in one SMS
steps.id: Hirer individu yang unik diidentifikasi dan NOPO-nya digabung dalam satu SMS
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates still produce separate SMSes, and the same phone number is not deduplicated.
steps.why_id: NOPO dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tetap jadi SMS terpisah, dan nomor telepon yang sama tidak digabung.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport, or no-mobile hirers are not sent an SMS
steps.id: Hirer opt-out, ber-passport, atau tanpa mobile tidak dikirimi SMS

steps.en: The SMS lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 1st letter
steps.id: SMS memuat NOPO outstanding dan merujuk ke 1st letter
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored in the database and cannot be checked from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di database dan tidak bisa dicek dari code.

steps.en: The SMS is sent to individual hirers in a batch
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke hirer individu dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: SMS sending and the reminder job are both switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dan job reminder sama-sama dimatikan di setting produksi.
